p.espaces.rg_d: Customs, product standards, entrepreneurship, investment platforms: official sources of information for each country.
p.espaces.rg_sub: Rules change often: ONE WORLD does not copy them, it opens the latest official source code and then you read them in your own language.
p.espaces.rg_g1: Global Trade Desk (ITC, UNCTAD, WTO): customs, taxes, rules and procedures on one page for one product and one country
p.espaces.rg_g2: Market access map (ITC): tariffs and rules of origin
p.espaces.rg_g3: ePing (WTO): Standards, labels and health regulations for products in the country
p.espaces.rg_e1: Access2Markets: Trade with the EU, step by step
p.espaces.rg_e2: TARIC: Customs codes and tariffs for entry into the EU
p.espaces.rg_b1: Business readiness (World Bank): starting a business, taxation, international trade, by country
p.espaces.rg_i1: I-SCAN (IOSCO): Check if a platform has been marked by a regulator before trusting it
p.espaces.rg_note: The site is open in your native language: please use the browser's translation function or, for the documentation, use "Understanding the documentation".For important decisions, consult a professional
p.espaces.cu_d: Customs duties, documents, international trade terms, free official tools, freight forwarders and carriers.
p.espaces.cu_sub: 24/24 ONE WORLD does not require you to submit a customs declaration: a licensed customs broker (freight forwarder) can do it for you.
p.espaces.cu_t1: Market access map (ITC, WTO): tariffs and rules for almost every country
p.espaces.cu_t2: Access2Markets (EU): Customs, Taxes, Rules of Origin, Step by Step
p.espaces.cu_t3: TARIC: Customs codes (HS codes) and tariffs on entry into the EU
p.espaces.cu_t4: French Customs: EORI, Customs Clearance, Simulator
p.espaces.cu_d1: Commercial invoices (value, origin, international trade terms)
p.espaces.cu_d3: Transport documents: Bill of Lading (sea), Air Waybill (air), CMR (road)
p.espaces.cu_d4: Certificate of origin (to obtain tax relief)
p.espaces.cu_d5: EORI number (for companies importing and exporting in the EU)
p.espaces.cu_d6: Depending on the product: sanitary or phytosanitary certificates, licences, CE standards
p.espaces.cu_inco: 2020 International Trade Terms Interpretation Guide: Who pays what
p.espaces.cu_i1: EXW: Buyer handles everything from Seller's factory.
p.espaces.cu_i2: FCA: The seller delivers the goods to the buyer's carrier.
p.espaces.cu_i3: FOB: Seller loads ship; risk and costs are borne by buyer thereafter.
p.espaces.cu_i4: CIF: The seller pays the freight and insurance costs to the port of arrival.
p.espaces.cu_i5: DAP: Seller delivers to destination, buyer pays import duties.
p.espaces.cu_i6: DDP: The seller pays all costs, including import duties.
p.espaces.cu_ban: Prohibited or regulated items: weapons, drugs, counterfeit products, protected species (CITES) and certain drugs.
p.espaces.cu_find: Find a freight forwarder or carrier
p.espaces.cu_src: Sources: ICC (Common Interpretative Terms for International Trade 2020), ITC, European Commission, douane.gouv.fr.

p.espaces.mt_sub: 24/24 ONE WORLD itself does not send money, nor does it earn any income from these links: you compare here, then send using the service of your choice.
p.espaces.mt_wb: Global Remittance Costs (World Bank): The actual cost of remittances, by country, service
p.espaces.mt_p_wu: Cash withdrawals, bank transfers, mobile wallets in many countries
p.espaces.mt_p_mg: Cash withdrawals, bank transfers, mobile wallets
p.espaces.mt_p_wise: Bank transfer at market exchange rate, fees shown before sending
p.espaces.mt_p_rem: Bank transfer, mobile wallet, cash withdrawal

p.espaces.mt_p_tt: Send to mobile wallet or bank account
p.espaces.mt_k1: Look at the total amount you receive: fee + exchange rate. Exchange rates that are different from the market rate are implied costs.
p.espaces.mt_k2: Choose how the person will receive it: cash, bank account or mobile wallet (M-Pesa, Orange Money, MTN...).
p.espaces.mt_k3: Identification is usually required for sending and receiving.
p.espaces.mt_k4: Never send money to someone you only know online, or to "unlock" prizes, packages, loans or visas: this is almost always a scam.
p.espaces.mt_note: Changes in service and prices: Always check their website when you ship.
p.espaces.ds_d: Sell without stock: Find a supplier, work out the real price, and stay within the law.
p.espaces.ds_sub: Direct marketing means that the products you sell to your customers are shipped directly from the supplier. It's easy to get started, but you still have to be responsible for selling.
p.espaces.ds_s1: Choose products that are permitted in the country of the customer: no counterfeit products, no unauthorized regulated products.
p.espaces.ds_s2: Find a supplier (the "Wholesale/Supplier" list here or on the wholesale platform) and order samples before you sell.
p.espaces.ds_s3: Calculate the real price: product, shipping, customs, VAT in the customer's country, payment costs and returns.
p.espaces.ds_s4: Tell your customers the actual delivery time.
p.espaces.ds_s5: Register your event: based on your business status, VAT and taxes in your country (see Trade Rules ).
p.espaces.ds_s6: Respecting customer rights: clear prices, including taxes, right of return, warranty, data protection.
p.espaces.ds_w1: Vendors who want to pay in full via unprotected bank transfer or cryptocurrencies.
p.espaces.ds_w2: Paid courses that promise to make you rich quickly.
p.espaces.ds_w3: Stolen photos and fake reviews: prohibited and punishable.
p.espaces.ds_w4: In the EU, parcels from outside the EU are subject to VAT from the first euro.
